rationale: The interpreter introduced an unsupported assumption about a default Celsius value for Design Ambient that is not present in the ticket, and it left nine open ambiguities that were not resolved. These issues prevent a complete and accurate implementation of the specified behavior.

findings.description: The interpreter adds a default value in °C for Design Ambient, which is not specified in the ticket.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported assumption about a default °C value or obtain clarification from the ticket owner.

sourceRefs.quote: Design Ambient | Numeric Input | User / Default | °F / °C | 95°F
For AC condenser inputs, the Design Ambient field shall default to 95°F (or equivalent in °C) and be echoed in output 3.7.

findings.description: Ambiguity about the exact list of Roof Type options beyond "dark" and "light" and representation of parapet/shrouding.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the full Roof Type option set and how parapet/shrouding should be represented.

sourceRefs.quote: The exact list of Roof Type options (beyond "dark" and "light") and how parapet/shrouding is represented (separate flags or combined options) is not specified.

findings.description: Ambiguity about the catalog of valid EC Model values.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the enumeration of valid EC Model values.

sourceRefs.quote: The catalog of valid EC Model values is referenced but not enumerated in the ticket.

findings.description: Ambiguity about unit handling for fields that accept both °F and °C.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on conversion rules and display format for dual‑unit fields.

sourceRefs.quote: Unit handling for fields that accept both °F and °C is not defined (e.g., conversion rules, display format).
